The *Satiuppajjanapañha* ("The Question on the Arising of Memory", Mil 3.7.1) is a section of the *Milindapañha* treating the arising of memory (*sati*) [SuttaCentral]. Listed among translations of the text is an English rendering by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].
In terms of parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral identifies a full parallel in the Chinese translation of the dialogue, T 1670b 2.60 ("The Sixteen Ways of Memory") [SuttaCentral]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus automatically aligns passages of the text with Sanskrit portions of the *Śrāvakabhūmi* in the *Yogācārabhūmi* and Tibetan passages in the *Saddharmānusmṛtyupasthānasūtra* (D 287) [DharmaNexus].
